story.heading: A showroom, then a clean install
paragraphs: You should see the unit in person before anyone cuts a hole in your wall. Come to Ridge Pike and stand in front of a few.
We handle the install and the service after. One shop, one phone number.
Salter's Fireplace & Outdoor Living serves people who live and work in Hatfield.
You'll find the phone and the next step on this page, not buried in a menu.
Come in when you're ready. We'll make the visit straightforward.
Neighbors already know the name. The site should make the first visit easy.
Bring questions. Leave with a plan you can follow.
Hatfield fireplace care, written so a person can act on it.

feature.heading: Outdoor rooms that get used
feature.text: Patios fail when the fire is an afterthought. We plan the hearth with the seating so you stay outside longer.

spotlight.heading: Ridge Pike, Eagleville
spotlight.text: The showroom is easy to find. Call if you want a quieter hour to look.

contact.heading: See it before you buy
contact.sub: Phone and address are listed. Confirm hours on the official site.

closing.heading: Come stand in front of one
